subject.why: The fishing rod is instantly recognizable with its rod, reel, line, and float.

category.why: Floats cleanly in three-quarter view over a centered sunburst pattern.

clean.why: Free of text, watermarks, UI elements, or characters.

framing.why: Centered with solid silhouette and sufficient margins on all sides.

colour.why: Bright, saturated green background provides strong contrast against the object.

detail.why: Shapes are clean and chunky with no noisy micro-textures or extraneous props.

style.why: Smooth 3D volumes and satin finish align well with the reference cards.

bg_colour.why: background is green (100% of the background); planned green
